jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Location:
This role leads a global team and can be based in any major hub in AMER or EMEA.

Summary

Salesforce is seeking a dynamic and transformational Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) to lead the global Process Transformation (Regrello & Apromore) sales organization and serve as a key member of the AI Labs Leadership Team. This executive will own the growth strategy and commercial execution for the Process Transformation business, driving revenue growth, new customer acquisition, expansion, and scalable go-to-market motions globally. The CRO will play a critical role in shaping the future of the business, bringing together AI, data, and automation to redefine how customers optimize and transform their business processes.

The CRO will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leadership, helping define the business’s long-term growth strategy and strengthen Salesforce’s position for sustained market leadership. Success will require an unwavering customer focus, deep understanding of market dynamics, and the ability to translate strategy into disciplined execution across a complex, rapidly evolving organization.

The ideal candidate will bring enterprise-scale leadership, deep technical expertise in business process optimization, consultative nature, systematic builder, intellectual curiosity, commercial acumen, and exceptional organizational agility — with the ability to anticipate market shifts, align senior stakeholders, build and inspire high-performing teams, and accelerate growth in the era of the Agentic Enterprise.

Responsibilities

Own the revenue strategy for Process Transformation, driving durable, predictable growth across customer acquisition, expansion, retention, and disciplined execution.
Shape and execute the go-to-market strategy, leveraging targeted industry plays, optimized account coverage, strategic partnerships, and differentiated market motions to accelerate growth and customer adoption.
Lead the evolution of the sales motion in the era of the agentic enterprise, helping customers harness AI, data, and automation to transform business processes, customer engagement, and growth.
Serve as a trusted advisor to CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, and other senior business leaders, positioning Salesforce’s Business Process Optimization portfolio as a strategic platform for enterprise transformation and measurable business outcomes.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Alliances & Channels, Industry GTM, and Enablement to deliver a unified, outcome-oriented customer experience and maximize revenue opportunities.
Own business performance and operating rigor, including forecasting, pipeline health, inspection, and performance management, providing clear, actionable insights to executive leadership.
Build and lead a high-performing organization, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and excellence while developing and retaining world-class talent.
Lead through organizational and market transformation, translating evolving business strategy into clear priorities, strong alignment, and decisive execution across the organization.
Serve as a strategic advisor to the Global CRO of AI Labs and the broader AI Labs Leadership Team, helping shape go-to-market priorities, investment decisions, organizational strategy, and critical initiatives that accelerate growth and scale the business.

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of enterprise sales leadership experience, ideally with deep expertise in AI transformation, process mining and optimization, agentic SaaS, and/or emerging technology, with a proven track record of leading large-scale, global revenue organizations. 3rd- or 4th-line leadership experience required.
Proven ability to lead complex business transformation at scale, including cultural change, operating model evolution, organizational design, and capability building.
Strong general management, strategic planning, and operational leadership capabilities, with a disciplined, metrics-driven approach to execution and business performance.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and C-level executives, translating those relationships into strategic partnerships and loyal, referenceable customers.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership in complex, matrixed organizations, with the ability to create alignment and drive outcomes across product, marketing, customer success, and regional field organizations without direct authority.
Executive presence and commercial acumen, with the credibility and influence to engage customers, partners, and internal stakeholders at the highest levels.
Outstanding executive communication skills, with the ability to articulate a compelling vision, simplify complexity, and inspire action across customers, field teams, and senior leadership forums.
Proven track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional sales leaders and go-to-market talent in highly competitive markets.
Relentless curiosity, agility, and adaptability, with the ability to prioritize effectively, navigate ambiguity, anticipate market shifts, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. jobs.description:
Job Title: Principal Product Manager (Cloud Media Solutions)

Contract

Location: Indianapolis, IN (Remote)

Visa: Independent Visa only

Summary:

As the Principal Product Manager, Media Solutions, you will bring strategic leadership, strong business acumen, and deep technical expertise to the Cloud platform. You are a critical thinker who thrives in highly cross-functional environments and can balance long-term vision with execution.
In this role, you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of Cloud Media Solutions, with a strong focus on modern, cloud-native, API-first communications across web, desktop, and mobile-first experiences. You will play a key role in advancing next-generation voice platforms built on modern telephony architectures, with a particular emphasis on delivering high-quality, low-latency audio experiences that power AI-driven voice bots and virtual agents.
This position combines individual contribution with team leadership, partnering closely with business leaders, customers, and engineering teams. You will drive product definition, development, and go-to-market execution, ensuring solutions are scalable, developer-friendly, and capable of supporting real-time, intelligent voice interactions at global scale. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern VoIP architectures and SIP-based communications, along with hands-on experience in real-time media technologies such as RTP, WebRTC, and advanced audio processing. A strong API-first mindset and a track record of building platforms that enable programmable, high-fidelity voice experiences for AI applications is essential.

Minimum Requirements:

⦿ 8+ years of experience in cloud-based solutions, with a strong background in product management for communications and media platforms
⦿ 8+ years of experience driving go-to-market strategy with customers, partners, and developers
⦿ Deep expertise in modern telephony, VoIP architectures, and SIP-based communications
⦿ Proven experience delivering high-quality, real-time audio and media solutions, ideally supporting AI voice bots, virtual agents, or conversational platforms
⦿ Strong experience with API-first platforms, developer ecosystems, and programmable communications Experience delivering customer experience solutions (e.g., IVR, Contact Center, UCC, QM, CRM)
⦿ Familiarity with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, and Media Solutions platforms
⦿ Proven ability to prioritize effectively and deliver in fast-paced, complex environments
⦿ Demonstrated success leading high-performing, cross-functional teams
⦿ Strong ability to influence and guide cross-functional stakeholders
⦿ BA/BS required

Desirable Skills:

⦿ Experience with AI-driven voice technologies, including speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), conversational AI, and virtual agents
⦿ Deep understanding of audio quality metrics and optimization techniques (e.g., MOS scoring, latency reduction, jitter buffering, codec selection)
⦿ Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
⦿ Excellent verbal and written communication skills
⦿ Experience building or scaling developer platforms, SDKs, and API ecosystems

Key Responsibilities:

⦿ Define and execute the Cloud Media Solutions roadmap, with a focus on modern telephony, real-time media, and AI-driven voice use cases
⦿ Lead cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, sales, support, IT, finance, and legal teams
⦿ Translate evolving market needs—especially around AI voice, automation, and real-time communications—into scalable, API-driven product requirements
⦿ Develop and deliver sales enablement materials and training to support go-to-market success
⦿ Support commercial and contractual initiatives with partners and customers
⦿ Identify and drive new business models and revenue opportunities, particularly around programmable communications, APIs, and AI-powered voice services

Technical Enablement:

⦿ Lead the evolution of modern telephony platforms, ensuring best-in-class performance in VoIP, WebRTC, and real-time media delivery
⦿ Drive deep expertise in SIP signaling, SIP trunking, and carrier interoperability, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and global reach
⦿ Own the strategy for high-quality audio delivery, including low-latency media pipelines, jitter control, packet loss mitigation, codecs, and audio optimization critical for AI voice bots and virtual agents
⦿ Champion API-first platform design, enabling developers and partners to easily build, extend, and integrate voice and media capabilities
⦿ Advocate for and deliver mobile-first communication experiences, ensuring consistent, high-quality media across devices and networks
⦿ Establish instrumentation and analytics to capture detailed customer usage and media quality metrics (e.g., MOS, latency, jitter)
⦿ Leverage usage and performance insights to design and optimize usage-based billing and monetization models ⦿ Enable customer transparency through in-app and API-based access to usage, performance, and billing data

Business Transformation:

⦿ Define and promote modern consumption models, packaging, and pricing tiers for Cloud Media Solutions, including AI-driven voice services
⦿ Ensure seamless integration with contact center (CCaaS), unified communications, and broader enterprise ecosystems
⦿ Drive monetization strategies for APIs, developer platforms, and AI-powered media capabilities
⦿ Partner with marketing and sales to deliver tools and strategies that support API-led, platform-driven, and AI-centric go-to-market motions Optimization:
⦿ Develop feature-level pricing strategies aligned with market dynamics and client margin objectives
⦿ Ensure product offerings are cohesive, differentiated, and clearly communicate the value of high-quality voice and media capabilities
⦿ Support product management in revenue forecasting and financial modeling at the feature level.

Note

- Telehealth coverage
- Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities
- Development and career growth opportunities
- Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays
- 401(k) matching program
- Adoption Assistance
– Fertility treatments

We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.

Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
Resources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance tools
Investment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on-the-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education support
Time to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
Pathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG

The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.

Job Summary

Job Summary

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for the strategic leadership of a platform, product line, or high-complexity product within the clinical research space. This role defines and owns product vision and roadmap, drives customer-informed strategy, and leads cross-functional execution across one or more significant product domains. The Senior Product Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy, influences senior stakeholders, and serves as a subject matter authority across the product discipline.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

Discovers and validates market problems through:
Collaborating closely with internal product stakeholders for market-facing product offerings.
Reviewing industry guidelines, specifications, and regulations on an ongoing basis.
Interacting with users/buyers of the platform to collect and synthesize product inputs.
Meeting with current and potential customers to understand the customer voice.
Identifying industry disruptions that are driving spending in the clinical market space.

Thoroughly understands customer needs and user centric design to define internal and external customer requirements.
Optimizes trade-off decisions during the development process.
Provides strategic leadership for the platform or product line, including technical, commercial, and market-facing aspects.
Leads the development of AI-embedded product strategies for the assigned platform or product line, defining how AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics capabilities will be prioritized, sequenced, and delivered to drive measurable client value.
Develops, maintains, and communicates product vision, positioning, value proposition, buyer/user personas, competitive information, and roadmaps for individual products within a product line.
Develops, owns, and maintains roadmap and product vision to gain stakeholder consensus and approval of product initiatives.
Owns the overall scoping of product initiatives in conjunction with setting and managing expectations of business leadership, Engineering, and Data teams.
Coaches and mentors Product Managers and Associate Product Managers in identifying, scoping, and presenting AI-driven product opportunities, ensuring consistent quality of AI feature development across the team.
Contributes to the preparation of statements of work, RFI responses, and marketing collateral.
Delivers presentations/demonstrations at customer sites, trade shows, and via web conference.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, skills, and experience to perform the job.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:
None

Qualifications/Experience

Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or software engineering; experience in clinical research or healthcare technology required.
Functional understanding of the broader clinical research process, clinical operations, and/or multiple clinical software systems (e.g., for clinical site support, patient engagement, safety, regulatory review, etc,)
Commercial software delivery experience in a 21 CFR Part 11 validated environment is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to make rapid and complex decisions that optimize across multiple, and at times, competing objectives.
Demonstrated experience incorporating AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics capabilities into product strategy and roadmap decisions, with the ability to evaluate feasibility, articulate client impact, and align AI investments to business objectives.
Results orientation, team player and holding self and others accountable for achieving results for customers and the business.
Demonstrated ability to operate and influence at the team level in a complex, matrixed environment with the ability to develop product strategies and execute across multiple sets of customers, internal stakeholders, and products.
Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical matters to technical and non-technical individuals, and to all levels of management.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills
Experience with Agile software development methodology preferred.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
: None

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:
0% - 5%

Pay Range

USD $91,980.00 - USD $143,000.00 /Yr.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, pregnancy, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager, Agriculture
jobs.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

J
ob Description:

DTN is transforming agriculture through data, intelligence, and technology that help agribusinesses make better commercial and operational decisions. Our products draw on proprietary and third-party data spanning farms, crops, weather, markets, customers, and the agricultural supply chain.

We are seeking a Senior Data Product Manager, Agriculture
to lead the foundational data products that power DTN’s agriculture portfolio. In this role, you will define how agricultural data is structured, governed, and delivered for reuse across customer-facing products, analytics, APIs, and AI experiences—including the data foundations required for generative AI, predictive models, and intelligent applications.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role with significant autonomy and influence across Product, Data Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Commercial Leadership, and executive stakeholders. You will define the strategy and roadmap for foundational agricultural data products, enable teams to build differentiated experiences on trusted and scalable data, and unlock greater customer and commercial value from DTN’s proprietary and third-party data.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Own the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for agricultural data products, including pipelines, canonical data models, APIs, and shared data services
Identify common data needs across DTN’s agriculture portfolio and translate them into scalable, reusable platform capabilities
Prioritize investments based on customer value, commercial opportunity, data quality, technical feasibility, and long-term scalability
Evaluate new datasets and capabilities for strategic fit, differentiation, commercialization potential, and their ability to enable analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases
Partner with Data Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and Product teams to translate customer and product needs into scalable data solutions
Drive data initiatives from discovery and definition through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement
Define requirements for data quality, coverage, freshness, reliability, governance, and accessibility
Drive alignment and resolve tradeoffs across complex data initiatives spanning multiple products, systems, and teams
Define success metrics across data quality, reliability, adoption, operational efficiency, customer value, and commercial impact
Use product performance, customer needs, and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve DTN’s data products
Identify opportunities to expand how DTN’s agricultural data supports analytics, machine learning, predictive models, and AI
Help establish the trusted data foundation required for DTN’s agricultural data to be reliably discovered, understood, and used by both people and AI systems

What You Will Bring To The Position

6+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex data, platform, or B2B SaaS products
Demonstrated experience leading products from strategy and discovery through delivery and ongoing optimization
Strong product judgment and business acumen, with the ability to make effective decisions in technically complex and ambiguous environments
Ability to balance customer value, commercial opportunity, technical complexity, and long-term platform strategy
Experience managing data-intensive products involving data pipelines, APIs, integrations, analytics, or data platforms
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes and warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data modeling, and governance
Experience partnering closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science teams
Ability to make complex technical concepts understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences
Understanding of the data requirements for machine learning and AI applications, including data quality, metadata, context, governance, and reliable access
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical, product, commercial, and executive audiences
Demonstrated ability to influence strategy and drive alignment without direct authority
Strong prioritization and execution skills across complex, cross-team initiatives

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience in agriculture, ag-tech, data platforms, market intelligence, geospatial technology, or another data-intensive industry
Familiarity with agricultural data, including farm and field data, crop production, weather, markets, agronomy, or agricultural supply chains
Experience building data products that support analytics, predictive models, machine learning, or AI
Experience with geospatial data, predictive analytics, or AI-ready data infrastructure

What You Can Expect From DTN

Competitive Salary
Unlimited PTO
Flexible working hours
Remote work model (position dependent)
Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
6% 401K matching
Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $115,000 and $149,000
. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,
trust
, and action
. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.
Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.
Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.
Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@dtn.com to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam.

J
ob Description:

DTN is transforming agriculture through data, intelligence, and technology that help agribusinesses make better commercial and operational decisions. Our products draw on proprietary and third-party data spanning farms, crops, weather, markets, customers, and the agricultural supply chain.

We are seeking a Senior Data Product Manager, Agriculture
to lead the foundational data products that power DTN’s agriculture portfolio. In this role, you will define how agricultural data is structured, governed, and delivered for reuse across customer-facing products, analytics, APIs, and AI experiences—including the data foundations required for generative AI, predictive models, and intelligent applications.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role with significant autonomy and influence across Product, Data Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Commercial Leadership, and executive stakeholders. You will define the strategy and roadmap for foundational agricultural data products, enable teams to build differentiated experiences on trusted and scalable data, and unlock greater customer and commercial value from DTN’s proprietary and third-party data.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Own the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for agricultural data products, including pipelines, canonical data models, APIs, and shared data services
Identify common data needs across DTN’s agriculture portfolio and translate them into scalable, reusable platform capabilities
Prioritize investments based on customer value, commercial opportunity, data quality, technical feasibility, and long-term scalability
Evaluate new datasets and capabilities for strategic fit, differentiation, commercialization potential, and their ability to enable analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases
Partner with Data Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and Product teams to translate customer and product needs into scalable data solutions
Drive data initiatives from discovery and definition through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement
Define requirements for data quality, coverage, freshness, reliability, governance, and accessibility
Drive alignment and resolve tradeoffs across complex data initiatives spanning multiple products, systems, and teams
Define success metrics across data quality, reliability, adoption, operational efficiency, customer value, and commercial impact
Use product performance, customer needs, and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve DTN’s data products
Identify opportunities to expand how DTN’s agricultural data supports analytics, machine learning, predictive models, and AI
Help establish the trusted data foundation required for DTN’s agricultural data to be reliably discovered, understood, and used by both people and AI systems

What You Will Bring To The Position

6+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex data, platform, or B2B SaaS products
Demonstrated experience leading products from strategy and discovery through delivery and ongoing optimization
Strong product judgment and business acumen, with the ability to make effective decisions in technically complex and ambiguous environments
Ability to balance customer value, commercial opportunity, technical complexity, and long-term platform strategy
Experience managing data-intensive products involving data pipelines, APIs, integrations, analytics, or data platforms
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes and warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data modeling, and governance
Experience partnering closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science teams
Ability to make complex technical concepts understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences
Understanding of the data requirements for machine learning and AI applications, including data quality, metadata, context, governance, and reliable access
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical, product, commercial, and executive audiences
Demonstrated ability to influence strategy and drive alignment without direct authority
Strong prioritization and execution skills across complex, cross-team initiatives

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience in agriculture, ag-tech, data platforms, market intelligence, geospatial technology, or another data-intensive industry
Familiarity with agricultural data, including farm and field data, crop production, weather, markets, agronomy, or agricultural supply chains
Experience building data products that support analytics, predictive models, machine learning, or AI
Experience with geospatial data, predictive analytics, or AI-ready data infrastructure

What You Can Expect From DTN

Competitive Salary
Unlimited PTO
Flexible working hours
Remote work model (position dependent)
Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
6% 401K matching
Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $115,000 and $149,000
. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

trust

. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.
Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.
